Chapter 1239: Chapter 3: Peeking into the Future (Please Subscribe)

Lin Yuan stood in front of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, extremely obedient.

This was the first time he faced a time life entity, the Thirteen-tier inheritance "Infinite Void" obtained from the Chaos Void, and the Thirteen-tier weapon Sky Void Tripod, though also related to time life entities.

However, the Thirteen-tier beings behind it had never paid attention to him, let alone engaged in direct dialogue.

"It is said that every Peak Venerable who earns a chance to possess an Ancestor gets some degree of guidance after meeting the Ancestor. The Ancestor, as a time life entity, can observe various futures, and the guidance is based on the Peak Venerable’s own future."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, he also longed for guidance from a time life entity.

Ultimately, this precise future viewing guidance is essentially a kind of trial and error.

Previously in the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan comprehended the Sky Void Tripod, and through the power of this Thirteen-tier weapon, had glimpsed some scenes of his own future.

But these scenes were fragmented, the information contained was extremely incomplete, and the future timelines involved might be just a minuscule probability of the future.

The reference value was minimal.

Whereas the futures observed by the Thirteen-tier Ancestors are extremely detailed, potentially determining multiple possibilities by watching different future timelines.

...

Lin Yuan was not worried about the ’Myriad Realms Gate’ being exposed.

Upon reaching the Twelfth Layer, the information surged forth from the depths of the Myriad Realms Gate—

It clearly states that the Myriad Realms Gate transcends all timelines, existing outside the past, present, and future.

Unless Lin Yuan actively triggers the Myriad Realms Gate, causing its aura to linger in a certain dimension, can it be detected by a Thirteen-tier time life entity of that dimension.

Otherwise, there is absolutely no chance of exposure.

Since arriving in this source world, Lin Yuan had never actively triggered the Myriad Realms Gate, nor used the World-Breaking Origin Force.

"I don’t know what my future looks like in the eyes of the Ancestor, how likely it is to step into the Thirteen Tier..."

Lin Yuan thought to himself. Theoretically, every Twelfth Layer perfect life form has the potential to step into the Thirteen Tier, but theory is ultimately just theory.

Some Twelfth Layer perfect life forms only have one lucky future in millions of future timelines where they step into the Thirteen Tier, which indicates the probability of reaching the Thirteen Tier.

In fact, in millions of timelines, billions of timelines, having one future stepping into the Thirteen Tier is already considered high probability.

More Twelfth Layer perfect life forms, in quadrillions of timelines, don’t even have one timeline stepping into the Thirteen Tier.

...

Compared to Lin Yuan’s quiet wait.

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun, who was observing different future timelines, appeared increasingly astonished.

"These futures?"

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun could not believe, "I have watched dozens of timelines again, and although each timeline is different, in the end, this little one steps into the Thirteen Tier in all of them..."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun felt dumbfounded, other Twelfth Layer perfect life forms need to painstakingly search through countless future timelines to find one stepping into the Thirteen Tier.

But Lin Yuan was the exception, as the Ancestor of Fierce Sun casually observed dozens of timelines, all ending with stepping into the Thirteen Tier.

Such a future was truly terrifying, even though the Ancestor of Fierce Sun had not yet observed all of Lin Yuan’s future timelines, just from the outcome of these dozens of timelines, it was likely Lin Yuan would step into the Thirteen Tier.

Stepping into the Thirteen Tier?

High probability?

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun fell into silence.

"I opened up an Ancient Country, left many inheritance secret techniques, and devotedly cultivated my descendants, yet through endless ages, never cultivated someone to the Thirteen Tier."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s thoughts spread, not only in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, but the other five great Ancient Countries as well.

Ultimately, the six Ancestors concluded that a Thirteen-tier time life entity cannot be cultivated.

With the abilities of an Ancestor, they can cultivate powerful beings of the Strongest Venerable level, but the Thirteen Tier? That’s dependent on luck.

Indeed, the Da Fu Ancient Country produced two Ancestor-level beings, but it didn’t have much to do with the Da Fu Ancestor. Before stepping into the Thirteen Tier, the status of those two Ancestors in the Da Fu Ancient Country wasn’t very high.

Even the Da Fu Ancestor himself hadn’t paid much attention to them.

The descendants that the Da Fu Ancestor valued are now trapped in time loops, while those he didn’t pay much attention to became Ancestors.

"But he..."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at Lin Yuan, not knowing what to say.

By watching dozens of future timelines, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun concluded that Lin Yuan becoming a Thirteen-tier is almost inevitable; whether or not he joins the royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, he will become an Ancestor of the same level in the future.

"Moreover..."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun steadied himself and began attempting to view other timelines.

Every moment, different timelines extend, representing countless possibilities.

And now the timelines the Ancestor of Fierce Sun looked at were the ones where he attempted to act to stop and kill Lin Yuan.

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun had no such intention; Lin Yuan, after all, was part of the royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country. Surely, becoming an Ancestor would be closely connected with him.

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun would not only avoid hindering Lin Yuan’s growth but also endeavor to help Lin Yuan, ensuring he smoothly steps into the Thirteen Tier.

However, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun was too curious about Lin Yuan; this almost guaranteed future of stepping into the Thirteen Tier prompted the Ancestor of Fierce Sun to make more attempts.

Timelines rapidly extended, depicting futures where the Ancestor of Fierce Sun acted to kill Lin Yuan.

"What is this..."

The Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s expression changed slightly.

Looking into this type of future timeline, initially indeed successfully killing this Galaxy Venerate, a Thirteen-tier time life entity making a move, the other party had no resistance whatsoever.
